title: 新冠疫苗
summary: 2026–2027 年度新冠疫苗 10 月 1 日起與流感疫苗同步開打，6 個月以上民眾公費 1 劑；65 歲以上與免疫不全者間隔 6 個月可再接種 1 劑。

bodyMarkdown:
新冠疫苗依病毒株變化每年更新成分。2026–2027 年度疫苗依 WHO 建議株，自 **10 月 1 日**起開打，6 個月以上民眾皆可接種公費疫苗；65 歲以上長者、55 歲以上原住民、醫事人員、長照機構住民與工作人員、高風險慢性病人與孕婦為優先對象。

可與流感疫苗同時分開部位接種，或間隔任何時間接種。
precautions: 對疫苗成分曾發生嚴重過敏反應者不可接種。接種後少數人可能出現注射部位疼痛、疲倦、頭痛、發燒；若出現胸痛、心悸、呼吸急促，應立即就醫。

en.title: COVID-19 vaccine
en.summary: The 2026–27 COVID-19 vaccine starts on 1 October alongside flu vaccine: one government-funded dose for everyone aged 6 months and over; people 65+ and the immunocompromised may get another dose 6 months later.
en.bodyMarkdown:
COVID-19 vaccines are updated each year as the virus changes. The 2026–27 vaccine follows WHO-recommended strains and is available from **1 October** for everyone aged 6 months and over; priority groups include adults 65+, indigenous people 55+, health workers, long-term care residents and staff, high-risk chronic patients and pregnant women.

It can be given with the flu vaccine in different sites, or at any interval.
